I'ma just put whatever I edited in bold.
ATOM COLLIDER 
**The Atom Collider is the last building unlocked in the top row of construction,** which converts **items** into atoms used for buffs. **Each atom is worth 10 million of a item (also known as a greenstack). You can spend atoms at the Atom Collider for bonuses such as getting discounts for stamps, making No Bubble Left Behind stronger, converting silver pens into post office boxes daily, or upgrading bubbles with atoms when they start costing 100 million or more of an item.** 
GREENSTACKING 
**A** greenstack happens when you have 10 million **or more of** an item. You’ll lose **the greenstack** if you go below 10 million of an object. The Lab **bonus, Unadulterated Fury** gives you +2% additive damage for every greenstack.  Having 20 million of an item counts as a single greenstack, and you can only get the +2% damage buff per unique greenstack. Start with the easy materials when green stacking, for example, oak logs! ES’s portal (active) is useful for greenstacking materials faster.

ELITE CLASES
The upgrade to your characters come in the form of elite classes, and are obtained in the 4th map of w4 (the one with the genies). Elite classes are currently the strongest form of a character, with a few excelling in active combat. 
Barbarian transforms to Blood Berserker (BB), excelling at cooking but not much else. BBs can increase their efficiency in cooking by chowing each mob (reaching 1 million kills on them). 
Squire ascends into Divine Knight  (DK), specializing in the w5 skill, gaming. DK's talents allow for active farming quite well as it can respawn all mobs killed after clearing them with large AOE (area of effect) skills while multiplying the rewards with orb. Active farming with DK will also boost printer output with the King of the Remembered talent.
Shaman rises to Bubonic Conjurer (Bubo), the best at Lab. Bubo has the highest amount of AOE in the game because the cooldown of the talents can be constantly refreshed with kills, meaning Auspicious Aura, Flatulent Spirit and Raise Dead will always be going off. The constant revivals means Bubo has the highest kill rate out of all active farming classes, allowing for the greatest rewards while cranium cooking to advance alchemy.
Bowman turns into Siege Breaker (SB); the w5 skill, sailing, is their expertise. SB also has the ability to active farm thanks to the Pirate Flag talent, but can't kill as much as DK, ES or Bubo. It's still important to get 1k-10k siege mob kills on SB as the Archlord of Pirates talent adds a **multiplicative** bonus to class EXP and drop rate (ex. if you had a 10% boost from Archlord of Pirates and 5x drop rate, it would turn into 5.5x drop rate).

content:
ELITE CLASES
The upgrade to your characters come in the form of elite classes, and are obtained in the 4th map of w4 (the one with the genies). Elite classes are currently the strongest form of a character, and can excel in active farming.

Barbarian -> Blood Berserker (BB), specializes in Cooking and can increase cooking efficiency by chowing (reaching 1 million kills or more) on a mob

Squire -> Divine Knight (DK), specializes in Gaming (w5 skill) and excels in active farming. Respawns mobs with *Divine Intervention* and multiplies the rewards of killing mobs with *Orb of Remembrance*. *King of the Remembered* boosts printer output the more orb kills you have.

Bowman -> Siege Breaker (SB), specializes in Sailing (w5 skill) and is decent active farming. Respawns mobs using *Pirate Flag* but doesn't respawn mobs as often as other active farmers. Recommended to get 10k-20k plunderous mob kills as *Archlord of the Pirates* adds a **multiplicative** bonus to class EXP and drop rate (ex. 5x DR + 10% bonus from *Archlord of the Pirates* will turn it into 5.5x DR)

Hunter -> Beast Master (~~garbage~~ BM), specializes in breeding. Boosts breeding exp and pets have higher power.

Shaman -> Bubonic Conjurer (Bubo), specializes in lab. Has the highest kill rate in the game because of *Raise Dead* and *Teneyecle* (when it's lvl 200). *Raise Dead* revives slain mobs and *Teneyecle* reduces the cooldown of skills by 3 seconds when you kill things, meaning you can constantly kill and revive mobs. This aspect of Bubo also boosts *Cranium Cooking* gains immensely, allowing for faster Alchemy development.

Wizard -> Elemental Sorcerer (ES), specializes in divinity (w5 skill). Instead of just respawning slain enemies, ES spawns the enemies with wormhole and can kill them instead. The wormhole enemies get stronger when kill more of them and also drop more items per wormhole enemy killed. This property of wormhole allows it to get basic materials of weaker mobs the fastest.

content: # W6 content has been added in! (About 1% of it, lol, I'll make the three skill sections soon enough!)

**ARMOR**

Helmets, chestpaltes, leggings, boots, pendants and rings make up your armor. They are the main source of defence for your characters as well as giving STR, AGI, WIS, and/or LUK. Stronger armors may have miscellaneous effects, such as extra mining efficiency, DR, or an increase to STR, AGI, WIS, and LUK (+all stat%). Most armors have upgrade slots, meaning you can apply upgrade stones to consume those slots in order to increase their defence and stats.
All the sovereign artifacts

**Active Farming**
Active farming refers to leaving your character on auto to kill mobs instead of leaving them afk. It allows you to get much more exp, money, and materials compared to leaving your character to afk because the base afk rate is much lower than 100% for a large part of the game. This is not to be done with skills such as mining or chopping as you won't get statues or obols with active skilling. *ONLY DO ACTIVE FARMING IF YOU HAVE AUTO LOOT AND HIGH CARRY CAPACITY OR THE MATERIALS WILL PILE UP AND EVENTUALLY CRASH THE GAME*
